name: nexora-rush
description: Nexora Rush - full-stack 3D browser arcade racing game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
